name: T12-WF11 - AI Sales Meeting Agent

parameters.content:
## 1. Protected Meeting Dispatch
NestJS authorizes meeting source/attendees and creates WorkflowRun.

## 2. Validate & Minimize Transcript
Redact/minimize before any AI provider call; backend privacy policy remains authoritative.

## 3. Meeting Analysis
Structured summary, decisions, risks and proposed action items with evidence.

## 4. Dedicated Records
Persist transcript, summary and pending action items through NestJS; notify via backend.

nodes.name: Code: Validate Meeting Input
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential required. Dispatch must originate from NestJS, never from browser/source connector.

nodes.name: Code: Normalize and Redact Transcript
nodes.notes: Regex minimization is not a substitute for backend privacy controls or a proper PII redaction provider.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { meetingId: $json.meetingId, workflowRunId: $json.workflowRunId, sourceType: $json.sourceType, transcript: $json.redactedTranscript, redactionMode: $json.redactionMode, idempotencyKey: $json.idempotencyKey, n8nExecutionId: String($exec.id) } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Save Redacted Meeting Transcript
nodes.notes: Backend must enforce transcript ownership, attendee scope, retention and final privacy/redaction policy; n8n regex minimization is not sufficient by itself.

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Get CRM Attendee Context
nodes.notes: Canonical meeting read path, but backend phase must allow a scoped n8n service identity and return only authorized attendee/CRM context.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $node["Code: Build Meeting Prompt"].json.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.1, responseMimeType: 'application/json' } } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Gemini Meeting Analysis
nodes.notes: GEMINI_API_KEY is read from n8n environment. Do not embed credentials in workflow JSON.

nodes.name: Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $json.workflowRunId, transcriptId: $json.transcriptId, summary: $json.meetingAnalysis.summary, decisions: $json.meetingAnalysis.decisions, risks: $json.meetingAnalysis.risks, idempotencyKey: $json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary
nodes.notes: BACKEND API: this dedicated summary persistence route is implemented by the T12 workflow backend patch; validate after applying migration.

parameters.url: ={{ ($env.BACKEND_INTERNAL_URL || 'http://localhost:3000') + '/api/v1/internal/n8n/conversation-summaries/' + ($node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary'].json.id || $node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary'].json.data?.id) + '/action-items' }}
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.workflowRunId, actionItems: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.meetingAnalysis.actionItems, idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Save Meeting Action Items

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { workflowRunId: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.workflowRunId, meetingId: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.meetingId, summaryId: $node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary'].json.id || $node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary'].json.data?.id, attendeeIds: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.attendeeIds, idempotencyKey: $node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json.workflowRunId } }}

nodes.name: HTTP Request: Notify Owner and Attendees
nodes.notes: BACKEND API: backend persists deduplicated in-app notifications; external channels remain out of scope for this release.

parameters.jsCode:
const p=$node['Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output'].json;const summary=$node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Summary'].json;const actions=$node['HTTP Request: Save Meeting Action Items'].json;const notify=$input.first().json;
return [{json:{workflow:'T12-WF11',status:'COMPLETED',workflowRunId:p.workflowRunId,meetingId:p.meetingId,transcriptId:p.transcriptId,summaryId:summary.id||summary.data?.id||null,actionItems:actions.items||actions.data||actions,notificationStatus:notify.status||'REQUESTED',completedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

main.node: HTTP Request: Save Redacted Meeting Transcript
HTTP Request: Get CRM Attendee Context
Code: Parse and Validate Meeting Output
HTTP Request: Save Meeting Action Items
HTTP Request: Notify Owner and Attendees

description: Owner: Tuấn Anh. Protected internal webhook. Transcript is minimized before AI. Summary/action-item/notification APIs require backend contract completion where marked provisional. The transcript persistence transaction atomically claims the WorkflowRun using the current n8n execution ID. A competing execution is rejected before AI processing. The graph has exactly 12 functional nodes.
